task.question: What city hosted the 2026 BWF World Championships in sports in August?
task.evidence: August 17 – 23 : 2026 BWF World Championships in New Delhi, India

answer:
The 2026 BWF World Championships will be hosted in New Delhi, India, from August 17 to August 23, 2026. 

FINAL: New Delhi, India.
